items.title: 10.22.2 Merits of the photovoltaic cell as a sustainable source of energy

items: The photovoltaic effect continues as long as light is present, making it a sustainable method of generating electricity.
A photovoltaic system is a renewable energy source that converts sunlight into electrical energy.
Photovoltaic systems use the sun's energy, making them a sustainable energy source independent of fossil fuels.

blocks.prompt: Explain the merits of photovoltaic cells as a sustainable way of meeting energy demand, referring to the photovoltaic principle.
blocks.explanation: Because the photovoltaic effect only needs light to excite electrons across the PN junction, the cell produces electricity for as long as the sun shines, consuming no fuel; sunlight is renewable, so the supply is not depleted, and the system needs no fossil fuels, avoiding their emissions and exhaustion.

items: Merits: works whenever light is present; renewable (sunlight); independent of fossil fuels.
